tiles.label: GMV (Delivered)
tiles.definition: SUM(qty x unit_price x (1 - discount)) over delivered orders, current quarter. Grain: order. Net of discounts, GROSS of returns. This is merchandise flow, not company revenue.
tiles.validation: Counting all statuses reports $1,894,948 (+26%). And 5.7% of this GMV ($85,278) sits on orders later returned - so GMV, not 'net revenue', is the honest label.

tiles.label: Platform Net Revenue
tiles.definition: GMV x 11% take rate. This is what Everrest actually earns - the number that belongs on the P&L, not GMV. The take rate is a stated assumption, not yet a data field.
tiles.validation: Board-critical distinction: GMV is $1,498,412 of merchandise flow; the company earns $164,825. Re-rating the take is a one-number change.

tiles.label: Delivered Orders
tiles.validation: Ties to the GMV order set - same filter, same grain.

tiles.label: Avg Order Value
tiles.definition: MEAN(net_amount) over delivered orders, EXCLUDING merchant M0007 (bulk wholesaler, ~50x median order). Grain: order. Median $82 shown alongside because the distribution is right-skewed.
tiles.validation: Including M0007 lifts the mean to $151 (+17%). The median ($82) sits well below the mean - a right skew, so both are reported.

tiles.label: Active Buyers
tiles.definition: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) with >= 1 delivered order this quarter. The demand side of the marketplace.
tiles.validation: Active merchants is a constant here (all 400 transact every quarter), so it was dropped for this - the number that actually moves and shows demand.

tiles.label: Return Rate
tiles.definition: COUNT(returns on delivered orders) / COUNT(delivered orders), current quarter.
tiles.validation: Using all orders as the denominator understates it at 5.0%. Only delivered orders can be returned, so they are the honest base.

tiles.label: Repeat Buyer Rate
tiles.definition: Share of active buyers with >= 2 delivered orders WITHIN the quarter. Measured per-quarter so it has a trajectory, not a static trailing figure.
tiles.validation: On delivered orders only, so cancelled-order churn does not masquerade as loyalty. Per-quarter framing lets the board see retention moving.

tiles.label: Top-Merchant Share
tiles.definition: GMV of the single largest merchant / total GMV, current quarter. A concentration-risk flag.
tiles.validation: M0007 alone is 15% and the top 10 are 21% of GMV - a dependency the board should see, not an aggregate that hides it.

headline: GMV was $1,498,412 in 2026Q2, down 2.4% QoQ against a seasonally stronger prior quarter - on this platform Everrest's own take is $164,825. 2025-11 is the demand peak at 1.9x a normal month, so plan inventory to it. M0007 is 15% of GMV: a concentration risk to watch.

checks.yoy_note: Year-over-year is not computable: the marts span a single 12-month window (2025Q3 to 2026Q2), so the current quarter has no prior-year comparator. QoQ is shown against the seasonal trend on the card; YoY is the next data requirement.
